how_tos.How to Apply for HDFC Bank Solitaire Cre: To apply for the Solitaire Credit Card, visit the HDFC Bank website, select the card and click on the 'Apply Online' button. You would be guided accordingly to complete the rest of the formalities.

faqs.1. What are the benefits of a chip card?: A chip card is embedded in a place it gives added protection against fraudsters.
faqs.2. What can I do if my Solitaire Card is: Inform the HDFC Bank Customer Care services via email, free number, or in person at the outlet and request them to block the card immediately.
faqs.3. Can I apply my chipped Solitaire Cred: Certainly. That's because your HDFC Solitaire Card comes with regular magnetic strips in addition to the implanted microchip.
faqs.4. Can I apply for the HDFC Bank Solitai: You can apply for the HDFC Bank Solitaire Credit Card just visit the official website of the card and click on the 'Apply Online' button.
faqs.5. What is the validity of the reward po: The validity of the reward points on the HDFC Bank Solitaire Card is 2 years from their date of accumulation.
faqs.6. How much do I have to pay for the ren: The fee for the annual renewal of HDFC Bank Solitaire Card is Rs.500.
faqs.7. If I am a self-employed individual, s: If you are a self-employed individual, your age is in between 22 years and 60 years to get the HDFC Bank Solitaire Credit Card.
faqs.8. What is the interest rate for the HDF: The interest rate for the HDFC Bank Solitaire Credit Card is 3.49% per month.
faqs.9. How many reward points do I earn with: For every Rs.150 that you spend on the HDFC Bank Solitaire Credit Card, you earn 3 reward points.
faqs.10. How much liability should I bear whe: If you lose the HDFC Bank Solitaire Credit Card, you carry no liability on fraudulent transactions when you report the loss to the bank immediately.
